g.text: Decoupled Dual-Portal Ecosystem with Stateless REST API Bridge (No Third-Party Intermediaries)
🔗 Microservices Interoperability: Both web portals operate in complete database isolation, exchanging clinical transactions via authenticated HTTP JSON payloads.
